story_anchor: Bo phim tai lieu dien anh theo chan cuoc doi va triet ly cua Phat Hoang Tran Nhan Tong, tu vi minh quan hai lan danh bai de che Nguyen Mong den quyet dinh buong bo ngai vang len non thieng Yen Tu sang lap Thien phai Truc Lam. Qua hinh anh nui non Yen Tu may phu, tu vien co kinh va sinh hoat thien mon dam chat Dai Viet, tac pham lam noi bat triet ly Cu tran lac dao voi kho bau Phat tinh san co trong tam, khang dinh tinh than nhap the va trao truyen bai hoc ve su tu tai noi tam giua cuoc song hien dai.

locations.name: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
locations.description: Ancient Vietnamese imperial palace courtyard with curved dark terracotta roof tiles, weathered red-lacquered wooden pillars, carved stone dragon balustrades on steps, open paved courtyard under overcast skies

locations.name: Yen Tu Mountain Ridge and Forest Trail
locations.description: Majestic rugged mountain ridge in northern Vietnam with steep stone pathways winding through dense moss-covered ancient pine forests, bamboo groves, drifting white mist, and dramatic rocky overlooks

locations.name: Hoa Yen Pagoda
locations.description: Ancient wooden Buddhist pagoda perched on the misty slope of Mount Yen Tu, weathered dark timber columns, moss-covered curved tiled eaves, stone pagoda stupa in courtyard, tranquil mountain backdrop

locations.name: Ngoa Van Hermitage
locations.description: Isolated wooden and thatch hermitage hut perched upon a high mountain crag surrounded by jagged stone outcrops, ancient gnarled pines, and panoramic sea of floating white clouds

locations.name: Vinh Nghiem Pagoda Monastic Complex
locations.description: Sprawling ancient Vietnamese Buddhist monastery complex with spacious brick-paved courtyards, ancient ironwood halls, carved wooden doors, shaded corridors, and a quiet monastic library archive

locations.name: Zen Tea Room and Meditation Chamber
locations.description: Serene minimalist wooden meditation hall with polished dark timber floorboards, fine bamboo roll-up blinds, low solid wood tea table, soft diffused window light, and tranquil interior garden view

key_objects.name: Woodblock Sutra Plate
key_objects.description: A rectangular hand-carved printing woodblock made of seasoned persimmon wood, deeply etched classical Han-Nom calligraphy carved in reverse relief, darkened with dried black pine-soot ink patina

key_objects.name: Bronze Meditation Bell
key_objects.description: An antique hand-cast bronze standing bell with a warm aged greenish-gold patina, resting upon a circular silk cushion on a dark polished timber stand, accompanied by a suede-wrapped wooden mallet

key_objects.name: Pine-Soot Ink and Bamboo Calligraphy Brush
key_objects.description: A traditional rectangular dark slate inkstone with freshly ground glossy black pine-soot ink, beside a handcrafted speckled bamboo brush with fine pointed horsehair tip on raw textured dzo bark paper

key_objects.name: Ceramic Zen Teacup
key_objects.description: A handcrafted rustic Vietnamese stoneware teacup featuring a soft celadon glaze with natural delicate crackle lines, filled with warm golden-green tea sending faint wisps of steam into the air
